name: Resa
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Resa is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in Luke. He is listed as the son of Zerubbabel and the father of Johanan. He is known only from this single reference in the Bible and represents a link in the messianic lineage.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Resa is mentioned as part of Jesus' genealogy in the Gospel of Luke, as the son of Zerubbabel and the father of Johanan.

keyEvents.title: Link in the messianic line
keyEvents.description: As a link in the lineage from David to Jesus, Resa is part of the fulfillment of God's promises of a Messiah from the line of David.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Zerubbabel
keyEvents.description: Resa is listed as the son of Zerubbabel, the Jewish leader who brought the people back from the Babylonian exile and led the rebuilding of the temple.

keyEvents.title: Zerubbabel's role in God's plan
keyEvents.description: Zerubbabel, Rhesa's father, was a central figure in the rebuilding of the temple after the exile, and through his lineage God's promise of the Messiah continued.
